children: Hazy Jane Tropical and Krush Test Dummy take Gold as BrewDog builds on its recent sweep at the 2026 World Beer Awards.
, a leader in U.K. craft beer and one of the world’s most recognised beer brands, owned by
(NASDAQ: TLRY; TSX: TLRY), today announced that it has been recognised again for brewing excellence in the prestigious Scottish Beer Awards.
Three of BrewDog’s best-selling beers, Hazy Jane Tropical, Black Heart and Krush Test Dummy were awarded at the evening held in Glasgow.

The wins at the Scottish Beer Awards build on the craft brewer’s success at the 2026 World Beer Awards, where BrewDog left with a sweep of 9 awards across 8 beers. This year's wins underscore the quality and excellence of BrewDog’s brewing team, its relentless commitment to great craft beer, and the enduring appeal of the BrewDog brand in its homeland of Scotland.

– (8% ABV) is a Double Hazy IPA loaded with tropical intensity, lush stone fruit and a silky-smooth juicy body that showcases the new-wave character of Krush hops. Part of BrewDog’s new illustrator-led premium range; Liquid Visions, the artwork was created by Barcelona-based illustrator Jordi Ros, it pairs bold colour, abstraction, and fearless storytelling with the beer's hop-forward personality.

– (5.0% ABV) is a New England-style Hazy IPA featuring natural passionfruit and mango flavourings. Unfiltered, smooth and mellow, it combines a juicy tropical fruit character with notes of passionfruit, mango, stone fruit and berries. Brewed with malted barley, lactose, torrefied wheat and malted oats, alongside hops and yeast, it delivers a soft mouthfeel and a distinctly fruit-forward profile.

(4.1% ABV) is a dry Irish-style stout, nitro-infused for a smooth, cascading pour, it delivers notes of roasted coffee, dark cocoa and caramel, balanced by chocolate and extra dark crystal malts. Black Heart offers a rich, smooth drinking experience and is suitable for vegans.
Rajnish Ohri, President, International, Tilray Brands, said:

“Winning across multiple categories is a fantastic achievement for BrewDog and a testament to the quality and ambition that runs through the brand. We’re especially pleased to see Liquid Visions, our new line of premium 440ml craft beers, recognised with an award so soon after its launch. It’s a great endorsement of the creativity and innovation behind the range and the team who brought it to life. More broadly, to see beers from across our portfolio recognised by the judges reflects the passion and expertise that goes into everything we brew, as well as our commitment to pushing boundaries and creating distinctive beers that people genuinely enjoy. These awards are a proud moment for the whole team and a strong recognition of the breadth and quality of BrewDog’s portfolio.”
